about: Settings for the lessons without a product brand: published to the demo Hub site. The maps open in the Atlas app from www.arcgis.com. No AI assistant: each lesson page has the prompt for a teacher's own AI tool. How-to videos and Report a problem link to the MapMaker Educator Support Hub, which covers the app the maps open in.

atlas.about: The Atlas app the lessons open in, from www.arcgis.com.

hubDemo.name: Lessons (demo)
hubDemo.lessonsIntro: Ten lessons that teach Grade 8 US History with maps, arranged by topic in the order most courses teach them. Each one pairs a map with an inquiry, a Word student sheet in English and Spanish, and a separate teacher page with the answers.

theme.about: Site colours the publishing notebook sets on the Hub site (Esri Calcite blue). Only these keys are changed.

classroom.about: Share to Google Classroom button on each lesson page. It shares the lesson's map, never the lesson page, which holds the answer notes. Follows Google's Classroom branding guidelines: approved wording, the official icon on the left (32 to 96 px, unaltered), Roboto Bold, a 20% black shade on the icon on hover, and the trademark notice in the page footer. The button is left out if icon is empty.
classroom.label: Share to Google Classroom
